name: Lowly
overview: Scripture contrasts the proud with the lowly, revealing that pride leads to shame, destruction, and divine disfavor, while humility is associated with wisdom and honor. The Lord judges among the mighty but calls His people to defend the poor and needy, demonstrating His care for the lowly in spirit. True wisdom and lasting honor come to those who embrace humility, as pride ultimately brings a man low and invites punishment.
